name: Life Insurance
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of wise stewardship and provision for one's family, as seen in Proverbs 13:22 where a good man leaves an inheritance for his children's children. This principle aligns with the care and diligence encouraged in Proverbs 27:23 to understand and manage one's resources responsibly. The protective symbolism of the blood in Exodus 12:13 reminds believers of God's safeguarding power, which inspires trust in His provision. Together, these verses affirm that prudent planning, including financial safeguards such as life insurance, honors God's blessings and secures the welfare of loved ones.
